scenarios.title_zh: 機場劃位、託運與入境查驗
scenarios.story_background: 你即將搭乘 BA156 班機飛往倫敦，正在機場報到櫃檯辦理託運行李、挑選走道座位，並在抵達後從容回答移民官的入境提問。

scenarios.title_zh: 餐廳點餐、堅果過敏說明與結帳小費
scenarios.story_background: 你在國外餐廳享用晚餐，想請服務生推薦招牌菜、明確告知嚴重堅果過敏，並在餐後確認帳單是否已含小費。

scenarios.title_zh: 早晨起床、鋪床與衛浴盥洗
scenarios.story_background: 從 500 Mini-Dialogues 精選的早晨生活微場景：家人互喚起床、鋪床與提醒關水龍頭，同時掌握美式與英式常用表達差異。

scenarios.title_zh: 廚房早餐、洗碗與倒垃圾家務
scenarios.story_background: 烤切片吐司、收碗盤、用肥皂水洗碗與倒垃圾的高頻生活動詞片語練習，建立居家起居的英文直覺。

scenarios.title_zh: 服飾選購、試穿尺寸與退換貨結帳
scenarios.story_background: 跟團自由活動或自助血拼必備！進店尋找夾克尺寸、試穿詢問含稅價格、確認 14 天退換貨規定並刷卡結帳。

scenarios.title_zh: 公園慢跑偶遇老友與相約喝咖啡
scenarios.title_en: A Surprise Meeting at the Park
scenarios.story_background: 陽光早晨在公園慢跑的 Jennifer 巧遇許久未見的好友 Adam，兩人自然寒暄工作近況、健身習慣並敲定週末咖啡之約。

scenarios.title_zh: 職場商務電話轉接、保留與留言
scenarios.title_en: Business Phone Transfer & Taking a Message
scenarios.story_background: 合作夥伴來電尋找行銷部主管，學會總機禮貌應對、佔線緩衝語氣，以及主客雙方自然交代留言與回電方式。

scenarios.title_zh: 飯店入住 Check-in、押金說明與房務需求
scenarios.story_background: 抵達飯店櫃檯辦理三晚入住，確認護照與雜費信用卡押金（incidentals）、Wi-Fi 密碼、免費自助早餐，並請房務部加送毛巾與枕頭。

scenarios.title_zh: 計程車跳錶溝通、小費禮儀與街頭問路
scenarios.title_en: Taking a Taxi, Tipping & Asking Directions
scenarios.story_background: 出國搭計程車前往飯店，禮貌要求司機跳錶計費（use the meter）、打聽當地小費文化，並在市區迷路時向路人確認地標與步行路線。

scenarios.title_zh: 身體不適、頭痛找藥與藥局症狀溝通
scenarios.story_background: 取材自《500 Mini-Dialogues》第 480–485 組與旅遊急救指南：突然頭痛不適、分辨輕微小毛病（minor ailment）與急症、尋找止痛藥錠或膠囊並確認過敏原。

scenarios.title_zh: 咖啡廳點餐、聊電影與下班週末邀約
scenarios.title_en: Coffee Shop, Movie Reviews & Weekend Plans
scenarios.story_background: 融合《McGraw-Hill》與美式聽力磨耳朵攻略：從約喝咖啡與點餐客製化開始，自然聊到下班收工、電影評價與西雅圖週末小旅行。

scenarios.title_zh: 開會發表意見、禮貌打斷與委婉反對
scenarios.story_background: 依據《McGraw-Hill》與美式口說攻略設計：在跨國產品週會中，學會在不傷和氣的前提下禮貌插話（If I may）、先肯定再提出不同觀點（That's fair, but hear me out），並用 cut to the chase 聚焦核心結論。

scenarios.title_zh: 專案進度追蹤、截止日提前與分工協調
scenarios.story_background: 面對客戶突然將專案截止日提前一週的突發狀況，學習如何主動預警（quick heads-up）、請同事幫忙審核文件（look this over），以及在滿載時專業地婉拒額外任務（stretched pretty thin）。

scenarios.title_zh: 約會議時間、行程撞期改期與 Email 確認
scenarios.story_background: 商務往來最常發生的行事曆撞期與改期協商：練習委婉提議順延會議（push it / reschedule）、坦白撞期（double-booked myself），並用簡潔專業的方式確認後續 Email 會議邀請。

scenarios.title_zh: 英文面試自我介紹、職涯轉折與個人優勢
scenarios.title_en: Job Interview Self-Intro, Career Move & Strengths
scenarios.story_background: 鎖定外商與跨國團隊英文面試最必考的三題：精簡介紹現職定位、自然說明轉職動機，以及不卑不亢展現專案實力與可靠度（solid track record / You can count on me）。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hi, I'd like to check in for my flight to London. My flight number is BA156.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 您好，我想辦理飛往倫敦航班的報到手續，班機號碼是 BA156。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Good morning! May I see your passport and ticket, please? And do you have any bags to check today?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 早安！請出示您的護照與機票。今天有行李需要託運嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Here you are. Yes, I have this suitcase. Could I also have an aisle seat if possible?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 給您。是的，我有這個行李箱。如果可以的話，能給我走道座位嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Sure, seat 15C is available. Do you have any carry-on luggage with you?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 沒問題，15C 還有位子。您有隨身手提行李嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Great! Just this backpack. I also have my customs declaration form ready.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 太好了！只有這個背包。我也準備好海關申報單了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Welcome. What is the purpose of your visit, and how long will you be staying?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 歡迎。請問您此行的目的為何？預計停留多久？

dialogue_turns.text_en: I'm here for tourism, staying for seven days. Here is my return ticket and hotel reservation.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我是來觀光的，預計停留七天。這是我的回程機票與飯店預訂證明。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Everything looks in order. Here is your boarding pass. Enjoy your stay!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 資料齊全沒問題。這是您的登機證。祝您旅途愉快！

dialogue_turns.text_en: Good evening! Are you ready to order, or do you need a few more minutes?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 晚安！請問您準備好點餐了嗎，還是需要多看幾分鐘菜單？

dialogue_turns.text_en: We're ready to order. Could you recommend a house specialty? I should mention that I have a severe nut allergy.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我們準備好點餐了。能推薦店裡的招牌菜嗎？我必須先說明，我對堅果有嚴重過敏。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Thank you for letting me know. I'll personally ensure the kitchen keeps your order completely nut-free.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 謝謝您的告知。我會親自交代廚房，確保您的餐點完全不含堅果成份。

dialogue_turns.text_en: That's reassuring. I'll start with an appetizer, and then have the grilled salmon, please.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 那我就放心了。我先來一份開胃菜，主菜要烤鮭魚，謝謝。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Excellent choice. How was everything with your meal tonight?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 很棒的選擇。今晚餐點都還合胃口嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: The food was delicious! Could we have the bill, please?
dialogue_turns.text_en_alt_locale: Could we have the check, please? (US common)
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 餐點非常美味！可以請您拿帳單給我們嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Here is your check. You can pay me directly or pay at the register.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 這是您的帳單。您可以直接交給我結帳，或是到櫃檯付款。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Thank you. Does this total include the tip, or should I add the gratuity?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 謝謝。請問總金額已經包含小費了嗎，還是需要額外填寫小費？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Wake up, sleepyhead!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 快醒醒，小懶蟲！

dialogue_turns.text_en: I'm awake. Look at the clock, it's too early.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我醒了。看看時鐘，現在還太早了啦。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Granny, have you gotten up?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 奶奶，您起床了嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: No, I have just sat up. Make the bed!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 還沒，我才剛坐起來。去把床鋪整理好！

dialogue_turns.text_en: I've made it. Don't forget to turn off the faucet.
dialogue_turns.text_en_alt_locale: Don't forget to turn off the tap. (UK)
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我已經整理好了。別忘了關水龍頭喔。

dialogue_turns.text_en: I have turned it off and put on my bathrobe.
dialogue_turns.text_en_alt_locale: I have put on my dressing gown. (UK)
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我已經關掉了，也穿上了我的浴袍。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Go to the kitchen. What will we have for breakfast?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 到廚房來。我們早餐要吃什麼？

dialogue_turns.text_en: I'm going to toast the sliced bread.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我正打算烤切片吐司。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Have you finished breakfast? Collect the dishes.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 你吃完早餐了嗎？把碗盤收一收。

dialogue_turns.text_en: I've collected them. I'm washing the dishes in the soapy water.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我收好了，正在用肥皂水洗碗。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Take out the trash.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 把垃圾拿出去倒。

dialogue_turns.text_en: I've taken it out to the garbage can. May I relax in my hammock now?
dialogue_turns.text_en_alt_locale: I've taken it out to the dustbin. (UK)
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我已經拿到垃圾桶了。我現在可以去吊床上放鬆了嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hello! How may I help you today?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 您好！今天有什麼我可以為您服務的嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hi, I'm looking for this jacket. Do you have this in a smaller size? Can I try it on?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 嗨，我在看這件夾克。這款有小一點的尺寸嗎？我可以試穿一下嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Certainly! Here is a smaller size. The fitting rooms are right over there.
dialogue_turns.text_en_alt_locale: The changing rooms are right over there. (UK)
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 當然！這是小一號的。試衣間就在那邊。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Thank you. Well, this one fits well! Does the price include tax?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 謝謝。嗯，這件很合身！請問標價有含稅嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Yes, the tax is already included in the displayed price. Will that be all for today?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 有的，稅金已經包含在標價中了。今天就買這些商品了嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Yes, I'll take it. What's your return policy if I need a refund or an exchange?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 對，我買這件。如果我需要退款或換貨，你們的退換貨政策是什麼呢？

dialogue_turns.text_en: You have 14 days with the original receipt. Please pay at the cashier's desk. Will that be cash or credit?
dialogue_turns.text_en_alt_locale: Please pay at the cash desk. (UK)
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 憑原始收據 14 天內皆可辦理。請到收銀台付款，要付現還是刷卡？

dialogue_turns.text_en: I'll pay by card, please. Thank you!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我想刷卡，謝謝！

dialogue_turns.text_en: Adam! What a surprise! I haven't seen you in ages!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: Adam！真沒想到會遇到你！我好久沒見到你了！

dialogue_turns.text_en: Jennifer! What a small world! I'm glad we ran into each other. Got a minute to catch up?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: Jennifer！世界真小！很高興巧遇你。有空聊聊近況嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Definitely! How have you been lately? You look great.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 當然！你最近過得怎麼樣？你看起來氣色很好。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Pretty good, but work has been crazy busy lately. I'm a little out of shape.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 還不錯，但最近工作忙瘋了。我的體能有點退步了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Tell me about it! Same here. That's why I started jogging again.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 可不是嗎！我也是。所以我才又開始慢跑。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Good for you! Hey, got any plans for the weekend? Want to check out that new cafe downtown?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 真替你高興！嘿，你週末有什麼計畫嗎？要不要一起去看看市中心那家新咖啡廳？

dialogue_turns.text_en: I'd be up for that! Saturday morning works for me. Text me the address!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我很樂意！週六早上我可以。把地址傳訊息給我吧！

dialogue_turns.text_en: Good morning, Smith Company. How may I direct your call?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 早安，史密斯公司。請問您要轉接哪裡？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hello, this is John Jones calling. Could I please speak with David Miller in Marketing?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 您好，我是約翰・瓊斯。請問我可以和行銷部的大衛・米勒通話嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Certainly, Mr. Jones. Just a moment, please. Let me connect you with that department.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 沒問題，瓊斯先生。請稍候，我現在為您轉接該部門。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Thank you for waiting. I'm afraid he is on another line right now. Would you care to hold?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 感謝您的等候。很抱歉，他目前正在通話中，請問您願意在線上稍候嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Actually, I have to step into a meeting. Could I leave a message instead?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 其實我馬上要進去開會了。我可以改留個口信嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Of course. Can I take a message and have him call you back as soon as he is available?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 當然可以。我幫您記下留言，等他有空時立刻請他回電給您好嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hello, I have a reservation under the name Johnson for three nights.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 您好，我用約翰遜的名字訂了三晚的房間。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Welcome! Room 504, a deluxe double room. May I see your passport and a credit card for incidentals?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 歡迎！504 號房，豪華雙人房。我可以看一下您的護照和信用卡作為雜費預授權嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Here you are. What exactly are incidentals, and what amenities are included in my stay?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 給您。請問雜費具體指什麼？我的住宿包含哪些設施呢？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Incidentals cover room service or mini-bar. Your stay includes free Wi-Fi and complimentary breakfast from 7 to 10 AM.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 雜費包含客房服務或迷你吧。您的住宿附有免費 Wi-Fi 以及早上 7 點到 10 點的免費早餐。

dialogue_turns.text_en: That sounds great! What's the Wi-Fi password, and is the breakfast a buffet?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 聽起來很棒！請問 Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼？早餐是自助餐嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: The Wi-Fi is HotelGuest247, all one word. Yes, our buffet breakfast is served on the ground floor.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: Wi-Fi 密碼是 HotelGuest247，全部連在一起。是的，自助早餐在一樓餐廳供應。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Is it possible to get extra towels and pillows in my room? Also, can you keep my luggage after check-out?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 請問我房間可以多要幾條毛巾和枕頭嗎？還有，退房後可以寄放行李嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Absolutely! I'll send housekeeping up right away, and we're happy to store your luggage at the front desk.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 當然可以！我馬上請房務部送上去，退房後也很樂意在櫃檯幫您寄放行李。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Excuse me, are you available? I need to go to the Grand Hotel on Main Street.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 不好意思，您有空車嗎？我要去主街上的格蘭飯店。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Sure, hop in! Do you know the exact address? Main Street is quite long.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 當然，上車吧！您知道確切地址嗎？主街相當長。

dialogue_turns.text_en: It's 125 Main Street. Could you please use the meter, and approximately how long will it take?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 是主街 125 號。請問可以跳錶計費嗎？大概需要多久時間？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Of course, I always use the meter. It should take about 15 to 20 minutes depending on traffic.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 當然，我都照錶計費。視路況而定，大概需要 15 到 20 分鐘。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Also, is it customary to tip taxi drivers here? I want to make sure I follow local customs.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 另外，請問這裡有給計程車司機小費的習慣嗎？我想入境隨俗。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Tips are appreciated but not mandatory. Usually people round up to the nearest dollar or add 10 to 15 percent.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 有給小費我們很感謝，但不是強制的。通常大家會湊整數或給 10% 到 15%。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Excuse me, I'm a bit lost. Could you help me find the Central Railway Station?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 不好意思，我有點迷路了。可以幫我指一下中央火車站怎麼走嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Go straight until you reach the traffic lights at the main intersection, then turn left onto King Street.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 直走直到主要十字路口的紅綠燈，然後左轉進入國王街就到了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: I don't feel well. My head has started aching.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我覺得不太舒服，我的頭開始隱隱作痛了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: That's too bad! Do you want me to call a doctor or check if there's a pharmacy nearby?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 真糟糕！需要我叫醫生，還是查一下附近有沒有藥局嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: No, it is just a minor ailment, not a serious illness. Fetch me some medicine for headaches, please.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 不用，只是小毛病，不是嚴重的病。請幫我拿點頭痛藥就好。

dialogue_turns.text_en: What medicine do you usually take, and where do you store it?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 你平常都吃什麼藥？你把藥收在哪裡？

dialogue_turns.text_en: An aspirin tablet, just to relieve pain. It is in the bathroom cabinet, on the bottom shelf.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 一顆阿斯匹靈藥錠，單純止痛用。在浴室櫃子裡最底層的架子上。

dialogue_turns.text_en: There's no aspirin in pills, but I found one in capsules. Is that okay?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 沒有藥丸狀的阿斯匹靈，但我找到膠囊狀的，可以嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Never mind! They are all pain killers. They work the same way.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 沒關係！它們都是止痛藥，效果是一樣的。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Twenty minutes have passed. Are you feeling better now?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 二十分鐘過去了，你現在覺得好一點了嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hi there! Can I get you something to drink? Would you like cream or sugar with your coffee?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 嗨您好！需要來點喝的嗎？您的咖啡要加奶精或糖嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Just black coffee for now, please. Actually, I'll also take a glass of water.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 目前先來杯黑咖啡就好，謝謝。另外也請給我一杯水。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Long day at work today, huh? You look kind of wiped out.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 今天上班超漫長吧？你看起來有點累癱了耶。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Yeah, it's been a day. I've been swamped all week, so I'm glad we called it a day.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 對啊，今天真的超硬。我整週都忙到淹水，真高興終於收工了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Seen any good movies recently? I heard that new thriller was amazing.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 最近有看什麼好電影嗎？我聽說那部新驚悚片超讚。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Honestly, it was better than expected, though for me it really depends on my mood.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 老實說比我預期得還好看，不過對我來說看這類片真的很看心情。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Weekend plans shaping up? What are you up to this weekend?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 週末計畫成形了嗎？這週末打算做什麼？

dialogue_turns.text_en: I'm going on a short trip to Seattle with some friends. I really need a break!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我這週末要跟幾個朋友去西雅圖小旅行。我真的需要好好放個假！

dialogue_turns.text_en: Let's cut to the chase. We're thinking of launching the new app feature this Friday. Any thoughts?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我們直接切入重點吧。我們打算這週五推出新的 App 功能，大家有什麼想法？

dialogue_turns.text_en: If I may jump in, I feel like this Friday is kind of tight for QA testing.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 容我插一句，我覺得這週五對品質測試來說時間有點趕。

dialogue_turns.text_en: I see what you're saying, though Marketing already scheduled the announcement.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我明白你的意思，不過行銷團隊已經把宣傳公告都排好了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: That's fair, but hear me out. If we rush it, a major bug could hurt user trust.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 這說得有道理，但請聽我把話說完。如果我們太趕，一個重大錯誤可能會傷害用戶信任。

dialogue_turns.text_en: I see your point, not fully sold on delaying though. What would change your mind?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我懂你的論點，但我還沒完全被說服要延期。那怎麼做會讓你比較放心？

dialogue_turns.text_en: A soft launch for ten percent of users might be one option. Am I making sense?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 先針對一成用戶小規模試推或許是個選項。我這樣說有道理嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Point well taken. Here's the bottom line: we keep Friday's date, but roll it out gradually.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 很有道理，我接受你的建議。結論就是：我們維持週五的日期，但採分階段釋出。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Sounds like a solid compromise. I'm totally on board with that plan.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 聽起來是很紮實的折衷方案，我完全贊成這個計畫。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hey, just a quick heads-up—have you seen the new project deadline? They moved it up by a week!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 嘿，先跟你提個醒——你看到新的專案截止日了嗎？他們提前了一週！

dialogue_turns.text_en: Can you believe it? We barely had enough time as it was. Did you send the draft file yet?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 你敢相信嗎？我們原本時間就幾乎不夠用了。你的草稿檔案寄出了嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Not yet, still working on it. Could you look this over? I'm a bit stuck on the budget slide.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 還沒，手頭還在趕工。你能幫我過目一下嗎？我在預算那頁投影片有點卡住了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Happy to help, let's review it together after lunch. Do you think we should ask for an extension?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 很樂意幫忙，我們午飯後一起來看。你覺得我們應該申請延期嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: It's worth a try. By the way, can you also cover the client demo slides tomorrow?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 值得一試。對了，你明天也能順便幫忙扛一下客戶展示簡報嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: I'd love to help, but I can't commit right now. I'm stretched pretty thin with Q4 reports.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我很想幫忙，但我現在沒辦法答應。我手頭的第四季報表已經讓我分身乏術了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Totally fair, thanks for letting me know. I'll loop in Jason and adjust our plans accordingly.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 完全理解，謝謝你直接跟我說。我會把 Jason 拉進來，並相應調整我們的計畫。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Thanks, I appreciate that. Keep me posted on what the manager says about the extension.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 謝啦，很感謝你。經理對延期怎麼說再隨時讓我知道。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hi! Just checking in—are we still on for our project sync tomorrow at two?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 嗨！確認一下——我們明天下午兩點的專案同步會議還照常嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Hi! I was wondering if we could reschedule. Something came up and I accidentally double-booked myself.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 嗨！我在想我們能不能改期。臨時有點突發狀況，我不小心把時間撞在一起了。

dialogue_turns.text_en: No worries, it happens! This week's pretty packed for me too. Should we push it to Thursday?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 別擔心，難免會這樣！我這週行程也排得很滿。我們要順延到週四嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Thursday works much better for me. Any chance we could do ten in the morning?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 週四對我來說好多了。有機會約在早上十點嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Let me check my calendar. Ten might be tight, but I should be free after eleven.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我看一下行事曆。十點可能有點趕，但我十一點之後應該有空。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Eleven works great! I'll send over an updated calendar invite and a quick recap by email.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 十一點太棒了！我待會寄出更新後的行事曆邀請，順便用 Email 簡短確認議程。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Awesome. If anything changes on your end, let's just play it by ear and message me.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 太好了。如果你那邊有任何變動，我們就看情況彈性調整，直接傳訊息給我就好。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Will do, I'll keep you posted. Thanks so much for being flexible—talk Thursday!
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 沒問題，有狀況我會隨時通知您。非常感謝您的彈性配合——週四見！

dialogue_turns.text_en: Thanks for coming in today! To kick things off, could you walk me through your current role?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 謝謝你今天來面試！先暖身一下，可以簡單帶我了解你目前的工作內容嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Sure! Right now, I'm in a product marketing role at a tech startup, leading regional launches.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 當然！我目前在一家科技新創擔任產品行銷，負責主導區域性的產品上市專案。

dialogue_turns.text_en: That sounds interesting. What's making you consider switching teams or moving to a new company?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 聽起來很有趣。是什麼原因讓你考慮轉換團隊或加入新公司呢？

dialogue_turns.text_en: I've learned a lot there, and now I'm looking for a bigger global scope where I can grow.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我在那裡學到很多，現在希望能往更大的跨國舞台發展，讓自己持續成長。

dialogue_turns.text_en: Makes total sense. How would your coworkers describe your biggest strength under pressure?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 完全合理。在高壓情況下，你的同事會怎麼形容你最大的優勢？

dialogue_turns.text_en: I wouldn't say I'm the flashiest speaker, but my execution is solid and people can count on me.
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 我不會自誇是最會炒熱氣氛的演說家，但我的執行力非常紮實，大家都能放心把事交給我。

dialogue_turns.text_en: That's huge for this team. Do you have any questions for us before we wrap up?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 這對我們團隊非常重要。在面試收尾前，你有什麼問題想問我們嗎？

dialogue_turns.text_en: Yes! What would success look like in the first ninety days for someone stepping into this role?
dialogue_turns.text_zh: 有的！對剛接手這個職位的人來說，前九十天達到什麼成果會被視為成功呢？

vocabulary.example_zh: 你看起來有點累癱了。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 忙得不可開交（像被水淹沒）
vocabulary.example_en: I've been swamped all week.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我這整週都忙到快淹水。

vocabulary.example_en: I'm glad we called it a day.
vocabulary.example_zh: 真高興我們終於收工了。

vocabulary.example_en: Weekend plans shaping up?
vocabulary.example_zh: 週末計畫成形了嗎？

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 直接切入重點、開門見山
vocabulary.example_en: Let's cut to the chase and review the numbers.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我們直接切入重點，來檢視數據吧。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 先聽我把話說完、聽我解釋
vocabulary.example_en: That's fair, but hear me out before we vote.
vocabulary.example_zh: 那說得有理，但投票前請先聽我說完。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 還沒完全被說服、持保留態度
vocabulary.example_en: I see your point, but I'm not fully sold yet.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我懂你的觀點，但我還沒完全被說服。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 很有道理、虛心接受你的觀點
vocabulary.equivalent_word: that is a very valid point
vocabulary.example_en: Point well taken—let's add an extra week for testing.
vocabulary.example_zh: 很有道理——我們多加一週來做測試吧。

vocabulary.example_en: Here's the bottom line: quality comes first.
vocabulary.example_zh: 核心底線就是：品質第一。

vocabulary.example_en: Just a quick heads-up that the client joined early.
vocabulary.example_zh: 先提個醒，客戶提前上線了。

vocabulary.example_en: They moved the product launch up by two days.
vocabulary.example_zh: 他們把產品發表提前了兩天。

vocabulary.example_en: Could you look this over before I hit send?
vocabulary.example_zh: 在我按送出前，你能幫我過目一下嗎？

vocabulary.example_en: We might need to ask for a two-day extension.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我們可能需要申請延期兩天。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 分身乏術、精力與人力滿載
vocabulary.example_en: I'm stretched pretty thin this sprint, sorry.
vocabulary.example_zh: 不好意思，這個衝刺週期我真的分身乏術了。

vocabulary.example_en: I was wondering if we could reschedule our call.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我在想我們是否可以將通話改期。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 行程撞期、同時段重複預約
vocabulary.example_en: Sorry, I accidentally double-booked myself at 3 PM.
vocabulary.example_zh: 抱歉，我下午三點不小心行程撞期了。

vocabulary.example_en: Should we push it to next Tuesday instead?
vocabulary.example_zh: 我們要不要改成順延到下週二？

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 見機行事、屆時視情況彈性調整
vocabulary.example_en: Let's play it by ear and confirm tomorrow morning.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我們看情況彈性安排，明天早上再確認。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 隨時向你更新最新進度與消息
vocabulary.example_en: I'll keep you posted once the client confirms.
vocabulary.example_zh: 等客戶一確認，我會馬上通知你。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 帶我一步步了解、概述說明
vocabulary.example_en: Could you walk me through your recent project?
vocabulary.example_zh: 可以帶我了解一下你最近的專案嗎？

vocabulary.example_en: I'm thinking of switching teams next quarter.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我考慮下一季內部轉調到別的團隊。

vocabulary.example_en: This role offers a wider global scope across APAC.
vocabulary.example_zh: 這個職位提供涵蓋亞太區的更廣跨國範疇。

vocabulary.example_en: You can always count on me to hit the deadline.
vocabulary.example_zh: 你可以完全放心交給我，我一定準時交件。

vocabulary.example_en: Before we wrap up, let's confirm next steps.
vocabulary.example_zh: 在我們結束會議前，先確認一下後續步驟。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 移民署查驗區禁止拍照與通話
cultural_notes.content_zh: 在 Immigration 排隊查驗時不可拍照或講手機，建議提前備妥護照、回程機票與紙本訂房確認單，回答簡潔明確即可。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 隨身與託運行李限重提醒
cultural_notes.content_zh: 手提行李稱作 carry-on luggage，託運行李為 checked baggage；若行李超重（overweight）會產生高額罰金，報到前宜先於機場磅秤確認。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 北美餐廳小費文化（15%–20%）
cultural_notes.content_zh: 在北美正式餐廳用餐，小費通常未含在帳單中（多人聚餐才可能自動計入）。結帳時可禮貌詢問 Is a gratuity included?，一般行情約 15%–20%。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 菜單標價多為未稅價（Tax Excluded）
cultural_notes.content_zh: 美加餐廳菜單價格通常未含州稅／地方消費稅（Sales Tax），結帳總額會略高於菜單單價加總。

cultural_notes.title_zh: Wake up 與 Get up 的差別
cultural_notes.content_zh: wake up 指「醒來睜開眼睛」（人還在床上），而 get up 則是「真正離開床鋪起身」。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 美式 gotten vs. 英式 got
cultural_notes.content_zh: 美式英語在現在完成式廣泛保留過去分詞 gotten（have you gotten up?），現代英式英語則慣用 got（have you got up?）。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 可分動詞片語：代名詞必須夾在中間
cultural_notes.content_zh: 當受詞是代名詞 it / them 時，必須放在動詞與介副詞之間：要說 turn it off / take it out，不能說 turn off it。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 垃圾名詞的美英差異
cultural_notes.content_zh: 美式日常慣用 trash / garbage（垃圾桶為 garbage can），英式英語則常用 rubbish（垃圾桶為 dustbin / rubbish bin）。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 結帳前先確認是否含稅
cultural_notes.content_zh: 美國各州消費稅不同，標價經常不含稅。買單前可問 Does the price include tax? 或 Is tax included? 避免結帳金額落差。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 務必保留原始收據（Original Receipt）
cultural_notes.content_zh: 國外店家辦理退換貨通常嚴格要求出示 original receipt，且吊牌完整未拆；結帳後請妥善收好收據。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 高共鳴接話詞（Empathy Bridge）
cultural_notes.content_zh: 當對方說最近很忙或很累時，別只回單調的 Yes！用 Tell me about it!（可不是嗎！）或 Same here.（我也是）能瞬間拉近距離。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 乒乓球原則（Ping-Pong Rule）避免句點
cultural_notes.content_zh: 回答完自己的近況後，順勢拋出一個延伸問題（如 Got any plans for the weekend?），讓對話自然來回流動。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 用 I'm afraid 軟化佔線與拒絕語氣
cultural_notes.content_zh: 告知不利消息時，用 I'm afraid he is on another line. 取代生硬的 He is busy，語氣專業又體貼。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 主動提供替代方案（Hold or Message）
cultural_notes.content_zh: 無法即時轉接時，主動提供兩個選項：Would you care to hold, or can I take a message? 展現積極的商務禮儀。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 辦理入住的「雜費押金（Incidentals）」不會真的扣款
cultural_notes.content_zh: 歐美飯店 Check-in 刷信用卡做 Incidentals 是「預授權（hold）」，用來擔保迷你吧、客房服務或設備損壞；退房確認無消費後數天內會自動釋放額度。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 歐陸早餐（Continental）與美式自助餐差異
cultural_notes.content_zh: 若飯店寫 Continental breakfast 通常指麵包、吐司、咖啡與水果等冷食；若想吃熱食煎蛋培根，可確認是否為 Full / Buffet breakfast。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 上車先禮貌確認「跳錶（Use the meter）」防喊價
cultural_notes.content_zh: 海外搭計程車遇到未開錶時，用禮貌問句 "Could you please use the meter?" 既不失禮又能保障透明計費。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 計程車小費：湊整數（Round up）或 10–15%
cultural_notes.content_zh: 北美搭計程車常見做法是直接把車資湊整數（例如 18.5 元付 20 元並說 Keep the change），或滿意服務時給 10–15%。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 美式 Pharmacy 與英式 Chemist 都是藥局
cultural_notes.content_zh: 在美國找藥局說 pharmacy 或 drugstore（如 CVS / Walgreens）；在英國或澳洲常看到 chemist。買非處方止痛藥可直接說 OTC pain reliever。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 藥劑形態說法：tablet / pill / capsule
cultural_notes.content_zh: tablet 指藥錠、pill 泛指藥丸、capsule 是膠囊；購買時若對特定成分過敏務必補充 "I'm allergic to..."。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 美式口語秘訣：用 kind of / honestly 軟化評論
cultural_notes.content_zh: 直接說 "This movie is boring." 聽起來過於強硬；美國人更常說 "I feel like it's kind of boring." 或 "It was okay, nothing special."，語氣瞬間自然有彈性。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 「It's been a day.」是大人最懂的默契感嘆
cultural_notes.content_zh: 不用冗長解釋今天有多累，一句 "It's been a day." 或 "I'm swamped." 就能立刻引起美國同事或朋友的強烈共鳴。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 美式會議反對公式：先肯定，再「hear me out」
cultural_notes.content_zh: 直接說 "I disagree." 在美式職場容易顯得有攻擊性。高手會用「認同＋轉折」：先說 "That's fair" 或 "I see your point"，再補上 "but hear me out" 或 "I feel like it's kind of tight"，把對立轉為合作解題。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 千萬別問同事「Do you understand?」
cultural_notes.content_zh: 問 "Do you understand?" 帶點上對下的質問語氣。想確認對方有沒有聽懂你的論點，應把責任放回自己身上，改問 "Am I making sense?"（我有說清楚嗎？）或 "Do you see where I'm coming from?"。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 「Quick heads-up」是外商最受歡迎的職場神句
cultural_notes.content_zh: 歐美職場非常忌諱「到死線當天才爆雷」。只要進度可能有變，先傳一句 "Just a quick heads-up..." 提前預警，不僅不會被責怪，反而展現你的專業掌控度。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 拒絕加班或插單：用「bandwidth / stretched thin」對事不對人
cultural_notes.content_zh: 說 "No, I'm too busy." 顯得生硬；改用 "I can't commit right now. I'm stretched pretty thin with Q4 reports." 同時表達「我不是不願幫忙，而是現有優先任務已滿載」，既守住界線又不傷關係。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 「Push it」指順延，「Move it up」指提前！別搞混方向
cultural_notes.content_zh: 英文裡「把會議往後延」常用 push / push back（例：push it to Thursday），而「把截止日往前拉、提前」則用 move up（例：moved it up by a week）。這兩個方向最容易跟中文「往後／往前」混淆，務必記熟！

cultural_notes.title_zh: 改期禮儀：提出改期的人要主動給「替代時段」＋寄新邀請
cultural_notes.content_zh: 美商文化中，若由你提出 reschedule，別只說 "Can we move it?" 就把球丟給對方；最加分的做法是接著給出具體選項（"Any chance we could do Thursday at 10?"）並主動說 "I'll send over an updated calendar invite."。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 外商面試切忌抱怨前東家，把焦點放在「成長與舞台」
cultural_notes.content_zh: 當面試官問 "What's making you consider switching?" 時，避免批評前主管或薪資；改以正向敘事："I've learned a lot there, and now I'm looking for a bigger global scope." 展現積極職涯規劃。

cultural_notes.title_zh: 面試反問必殺題：「前 90 天的成功指標是什麼？」
cultural_notes.content_zh: 聽到 "Do you have any questions for us?" 千萬別只說 "No, I'm good."！問 "What would success look like in the first 90 days?" 能瞬間讓面試官把你代入正式員工的畫面，好感度大幅飆升。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I'd like to have the {{dish}}, and please make it without {{exclude}}.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我想要點{{dish}}，並且請不要加{{exclude}}。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 點餐時同時清楚交代不吃或過敏的食材，比事後退菜更安全禮貌。
sentence_patterns.example_en: I'd like to have the grilled salmon, and please make it without nuts.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我想要點烤鮭魚，並且請不要加堅果。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Excuse me, where is the nearest {{place}}, and how do I get there?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 不好意思，請問最近的{{place}}在哪裡，我該怎麼走過去？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 問路開頭先說 Excuse me 引起注意，加上 the nearest 最容易得到具體方向。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Excuse me, where is the nearest subway station, and how do I get there?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 不好意思，請問最近的地鐵站在哪裡，我該怎麼走過去？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Could you please send extra {{item}} to my room?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 能否請你們送額外的{{item}}到我的房間？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 打電話給飯店櫃檯或房務（housekeeping）時最標準禮貌的請求句。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Could you please send extra towels to my room?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 能否請你們送額外的毛巾到我的房間？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: This is an emergency. My {{item}} is missing, and I need to file a report.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 這是緊急狀況。我的{{item}}不見了，我需要報案做紀錄。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 報失或申請旅遊保險理賠時，file a report（報案立卷）是關鍵詞。
sentence_patterns.example_en: This is an emergency. My passport is missing, and I need to file a report.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 這是緊急狀況。我的護照不見了，我需要報案做紀錄。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: It's time to {{action}}.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 該是{{action}}的時候了。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 日常作息提醒最萬用的開頭，後面直接接原形動詞片語。
sentence_patterns.example_en: It's time to get up.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 該起床了。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Have you {{task}} yet?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 你已經{{task}}了嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 用現在完成式確認某件家事或生活步驟完成了沒，回答常用 I've already ...。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Have you taken out the trash yet?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 你已經拿去倒垃圾了嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: How may I help you? Are you looking for {{target}}?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我可以如何為您服務？您有在找{{target}}嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 進店時最常聽到的店員招呼語，聽懂即可微笑回應 I'm just browsing.
sentence_patterns.example_en: How may I help you? Are you looking for anything in particular?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我可以如何為您服務？您有在找任何特定款式嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Would you like to try it on? The {{room}} are right over there.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 您想試穿看看嗎？{{room}}就在那邊。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 美式多說 fitting rooms，英式與百貨也常見 changing rooms / dressing rooms。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Would you like to try it on? The fitting rooms are right over there.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 您想試穿看看嗎？試衣間就在那邊。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: How would you like to pay? Will that be {{method}}?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 您想怎麼付款呢？要{{method}}？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 結帳櫃檯必聽句，回覆 I'll pay by card / in cash 即可。
sentence_patterns.example_en: How would you like to pay? Will that be cash or credit?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 您想怎麼付款呢？要付現還是刷卡？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Thank you, I'm just {{action}}.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 謝謝，我只是{{action}}。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 想自己慢慢逛不被店員跟緊時，最禮貌又自然的回應。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Thank you, I'm just browsing.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 謝謝，我只是隨意看看。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: It doesn't fit well. It's too {{fit}}.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 這件不太合身，它太{{fit}}了。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 試穿後快速向店員形容版型問題的萬用模板。
sentence_patterns.example_en: It doesn't fit well. It's too tight.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 這件不太合身，它太緊了。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Do you have this in {{option}}?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 這件有{{option}}嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 購物最高頻萬用句！尺寸、顏色、材質都能直接套進 in 後面。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Do you have this in a smaller size?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 這件有小一點的尺寸嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I'd like to {{action}}, please.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我想要{{action}}，謝謝。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 結帳、退貨或換貨時用 I'd like to... 禮貌又清楚。

choices.en: exchange this for a different size

sentence_patterns.example_en: I'd like to exchange this for a different size, please.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我想要把這件換成其他尺寸，謝謝。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I have a reservation under the name [LAST_NAME] for [NIGHTS].
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我用 [姓氏] 的名字預訂了 [幾晚] 的房間。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 飯店 Check-in 第一句萬用模板，把姓氏與入住天數套入即可。
sentence_patterns.example_en: I have a reservation under the name Chen for three nights.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我用陳先生的名字預訂了三晚的房間。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Is it possible to get [REQUEST]?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 請問可以幫我 [提出房務/退房需求] 嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 比直接說 Give me... 禮貌許多，適用於多要備品、延遲退房或寄放行李。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Is it possible to get extra towels and pillows?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 請問可以多給我毛巾和枕頭嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Could you take me to [PLACE], and please use the meter?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 可以載我到 [地點] 嗎？請幫我跳錶計費。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 上計程車一次講清目的地與跳錶需求。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Could you take me to this address, and please use the meter?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 可以載我去這個地址嗎？請幫我跳錶計費。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: How do I get to [DESTINATION]? Do I need to transfer?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我要怎麼去 [目的地]？需要轉車嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 搭地鐵、公車或問路時最強組合句。
sentence_patterns.example_en: How do I get to the nearest subway station? Do I need to transfer?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我要怎麼去最近的地鐵站？需要轉車嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I'm not feeling well. I have [SYMPTOM]. Is there a pharmacy nearby?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我覺得不舒服，我有 [症狀]。請問附近有藥局嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 旅途中身體微恙時向飯店櫃檯或路人求助的核心句型。
sentence_patterns.example_en: I'm not feeling well. I have a bad headache. Is there a pharmacy nearby?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我覺得不舒服，我頭痛得很厲害。附近有藥局嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Do you have any medicine for [ISSUE] in [FORM]?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 請問有 [劑型] 的 [症狀] 藥嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 在藥局購買非處方成藥時用來指定藥錠或膠囊。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Do you have any medicine for headaches in capsules?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 請問有膠囊狀的頭痛藥嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I'd like [DRINK], [OPTION], please.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 請給我一杯 [飲品]，[客製需求]，謝謝。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 在咖啡廳或酒吧點餐最自然道地的說法（比 I want 更有禮貌）。
sentence_patterns.example_en: I'd like some coffee, with cream and sugar, please.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 請給我一杯咖啡，加奶精和糖，謝謝。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: What are you up to [TIME]? I was wondering if you want to [ACTIVITY].
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 你 [時間] 打算做什麼？我想問你要不要 [活動]？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 美式自然邀約公式：先輕鬆問對方安排，再用 I was wondering 降低壓迫感。
sentence_patterns.example_en: What are you up to this weekend? I was wondering if you want to see a movie.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 你這週末打算做什麼？我在想要不要一起看場電影。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: That's fair, but hear me out—I feel like [ISSUE] is kind of [CONCERN].
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 那說得有理，但先聽我說完——我覺得 [議題] 有點 [顧慮]。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 美式會議高情商反對公式：先認可對方，再用 I feel like + kind of 雙重軟化。
sentence_patterns.example_en: That's fair, but hear me out—I feel like this Friday is kind of tight for QA testing.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 那說得有理，但先聽我說完——我覺得這週五對品質測試來說有點趕。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: [PROPOSAL] might be one option though. Am I making sense?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: [替代方案] 或許是個選項。我這樣說合理嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 提出替代解方時用 might be one option 保留討論空間，結尾用 Am I making sense? 邀請共鳴。

choices.en: A soft launch for ten percent of users
Running a quick user survey first

sentence_patterns.example_en: A soft launch for ten percent of users might be one option though. Am I making sense?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 先針對一成用戶小規模試推或許是個選項。我這樣說合理嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Could you look [DOCUMENT] over? I'm a bit stuck on [PART].
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 你能幫我過目一下 [文件] 嗎？我在 [部分] 有點卡住了。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 請同事幫忙看資料最自然親切的說法，直接點出卡關處能節省彼此時間。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Could you look this draft over? I'm a bit stuck on the budget slide.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 你能幫我過目一下這份草稿嗎？我在預算這頁投影片有點卡住了。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I can't commit right now—I'm stretched pretty thin with [TASK].
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我現在沒辦法答應——我手頭的 [任務] 已經讓我分身乏術了。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 禮貌但堅定守住工作量邊界：先說明無法承諾，再交代目前滿載的具體原因。
sentence_patterns.example_en: I can't commit right now—I'm stretched pretty thin with Q4 reports.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我現在沒辦法答應——我手頭的第四季報表已經讓我分身乏術了。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I was wondering if we could reschedule [EVENT]. Any chance we could push it to [NEW_TIME]?
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我在想我們是否能把 [會議] 改期。有機會順延到 [新時間] 嗎？
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: I was wondering if + Any chance we could 雙重緩衝，讓改期要求客氣又有商量餘地。
sentence_patterns.example_en: I was wondering if we could reschedule our project sync. Any chance we could push it to Thursday at eleven?
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我在想我們是否能把專案同步會改期。有機會順延到週四上午十一點嗎？

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I'll send over [ITEM] and keep you posted if [CONDITION].
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我會寄出 [項目]，如果 [狀況] 我再隨時通知您。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 商務約時間最俐落的收尾模板，清楚交代下一步動作與回報承諾。
sentence_patterns.example_en: I'll send over an updated calendar invite and keep you posted if anything changes.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我會寄出更新後的行事曆邀請，如果有任何變動我再隨時通知您。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: Right now, I'm in a [ROLE] role at a [COMPANY], focusing on [FOCUS].
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 目前我在一家 [公司類型] 擔任 [職位]，主要專注於 [核心業務]。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 一句話精準定位現職（30 秒電梯簡報核心），比 "I work in marketing department" 更道地有力。
sentence_patterns.example_en: Right now, I'm in a product marketing role at a tech startup, focusing on regional launches.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 目前我在一家科技新創公司擔任產品行銷，主要專注於區域產品上市。

sentence_patterns.formula_en: I wouldn't say I'm [EXTREME], but [STRENGTH] and people can count on me.
sentence_patterns.formula_zh: 我不敢說自己是 [誇張特質]，但我的 [核心優勢]，而且大家都能放心信賴我。
sentence_patterns.pragmatic_note: 美式高分面試語氣：先輕微謙遜收斂，再落實到具體可靠度，聽起來真誠又有說服力。

choices.zh: 最會炒熱氣氛的演說家

choices.en: the loudest voice in the room

choices.zh: 我在高壓下能保持冷靜

sentence_patterns.example_en: I wouldn't say I'm the flashiest speaker, but my execution is solid and people can count on me.
sentence_patterns.example_zh: 我不敢說自己是最會炒熱氣氛的演說家，但我的執行力很紮實，而且大家都能放心信賴我。

expression_groups.title_zh: 開啟話題與自然徵詢感受（Small Talk Bridge）
傳遞壞消息與委婉拒絕（Softening 軟化語氣）
禮貌請求許可與緩衝說法（Hedging）
打招呼與關心近況（正式 ➜ 俚語光譜）
請對方稍候與等一下（正式 ➜ 慣用語光譜）
美式弱化語氣：kind of / pretty / feel like（告別死板教科書）

expression_groups.title_en: Being Busy & Calling It a Day
expression_groups.title_zh: 形容超忙、共鳴接話與準備收工（正式 ➜ 慣用語光譜）
職場緩衝反對、婉拒插單與改期（教科書 ➜ 美式專業口語）

expression_groups.title_en: Getting to the Point & Expressing Reliability
expression_groups.title_zh: 會議聚焦重點、事前預警與展現可靠度（正式 ➜ 慣用語光譜）

expressions.standard_en: Do you like your new job?
expressions.native_en: How do you like your new job so far?
expressions.meaning_zh: 到目前為止，你覺得新工作怎麼樣？
expressions.idiom_note: 把封閉式 Yes/No 問句改成 How do you like...? 並加上 so far，能自然引導對方分享更多細節。

expressions.native_en: Can you believe it?
expressions.meaning_zh: 真的假的？你能相信嗎？
expressions.idiom_note: 美國人極常用的情緒共鳴開場白，並非真的問相不相信，而是表達驚訝。

expressions.native_en: Do you happen to have the time?
expressions.meaning_zh: 請問您剛好有看時間嗎？
expressions.idiom_note: 加上 happen to（恰巧）能大幅降低向陌生人發問的唐突感。

expressions.standard_en: I cannot come to dinner tonight.
expressions.native_en: I'm afraid I can't join you for dinner tonight.
expressions.meaning_zh: 很抱歉，我今晚恐怕無法一起吃晚餐了。
expressions.idiom_note: 句首加上 I'm afraid... 能有效軟化拒絕帶來的生硬感，顯得真誠有禮。

expressions.standard_en: We do not have any more in stock.
expressions.native_en: I'm afraid we don't have any more left.
expressions.meaning_zh: 不好意思，我們已經售完了。
expressions.idiom_note: 門市與客服最常聽見的溫和缺貨說法。

expressions.native_en: I'm afraid you misunderstood what I meant.
expressions.meaning_zh: 恐怕您有點誤會我的意思了。
expressions.idiom_note: 避免直接指責對方錯了，用緩衝語降低對立與尷尬。

expressions.native_en: Do you mind if I open the window? It's getting a bit stuffy.
expressions.meaning_zh: 你介意我開個窗嗎？這裡有點悶。
expressions.idiom_note: 用 Do you mind if I...? 把決定權交給對方，並補上原因，非常體貼道地。

expressions.standard_en: Wait for me. I will answer the phone.
expressions.native_en: Sorry, do you mind if I take this call? I'll just be a minute.
expressions.meaning_zh: 抱歉，介意我接一下這通電話嗎？只要一分鐘。
expressions.idiom_note: 取代命令式的 Wait，加上時間承諾 just be a minute 展現禮節。

expressions.standard_en: I will think about this product.
expressions.native_en: I have to think it over.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我得再仔細考慮一下。
expressions.idiom_note: think it over = 仔細斟酌，逛街想委婉離開時超好用。

expressions.native_en: Good morning. How are you doing today?
expressions.meaning_zh: 早安。您今天過得如何？（客戶、長官、正式會議）
expressions.idiom_note: 最安全得體的商務問候。

expressions.native_en: How's it going? How have you been?
expressions.meaning_zh: 近來如何？過得怎麼樣？（日常熟人與同事）
expressions.idiom_note: 美國最普遍的日常萬用招呼。

expressions.native_en: How you been? What's up?
expressions.meaning_zh: 最近如何？有什麼新鮮事？（朋友同儕）
expressions.idiom_note: 口語常省略 have，快速唸成 How ya been?

expressions.native_en: Wassup? How's it shakin'?
expressions.meaning_zh: 嘿！最近瞎忙啥呢？（極親近好友、年輕族群）
expressions.idiom_note: 極口語街頭俚語，請勿用於正式商務場合。

expressions.native_en: Would you care to hold, please? Just a moment, please.
expressions.meaning_zh: 請問您願意稍候嗎？請稍等片刻。（總機與櫃檯）
expressions.idiom_note: 商務電話最禮貌的保留說法。

expressions.native_en: Hold on a second. Wait a moment.
expressions.meaning_zh: 請等一下。（辦公與日常通用）
expressions.idiom_note: 自然不拘謹的標準表達。

expressions.native_en: Hang on a sec. Just a sec.
expressions.meaning_zh: 等我一下下。（朋友熟人快節奏口語）
expressions.idiom_note: to hang on = to wait，sec 為 second 的口語縮寫。

expressions.native_en: Hold your horses! Keep your shirt on!
expressions.meaning_zh: 別急！耐心點！（熟人間幽默提醒別性急）
expressions.idiom_note: 字面為「拉住你的馬」，常用於半開玩笑叫對方冷靜別催。

expressions.native_en: Yeah, I'm kind of tired too.
expressions.meaning_zh: 是啊，我今天也有點累。
expressions.idiom_note: 加上 kind of 讓語氣更口語放鬆，不會像機器人背書。

expressions.native_en: I feel like it's kind of boring.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我覺得這部片好像有點無聊。
expressions.idiom_note: 用 I feel like + kind of 表達主觀評價，避免太直接冒犯喜歡這部片的朋友。

expressions.native_en: I feel like we should head out.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我覺得我們差不多該出發／閃人了。
expressions.idiom_note: head out 是美國人最常用來取代 leave 的道地片語。

expressions.native_en: Yeah, it's pretty busy tonight.
expressions.meaning_zh: 對啊，今晚這裡人還滿多的。
expressions.idiom_note: 口語中用 pretty 取代 very，聽起來立刻更像母語人士。

expressions.native_en: It's not that I don't like it.
expressions.meaning_zh: 也不是說我不喜歡啦（委婉澄清）。
expressions.idiom_note: 被誤會時用 It's not that... 開頭，語氣委婉且自然。

expressions.native_en: I'm swamped right now.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我現在忙到快淹水了。
expressions.idiom_note: swamped 原指小船進水沉沒，比喻工作量爆棚。

expressions.native_en: I'm completely snowed under.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我被工作壓得喘不過氣（像被大雪埋住）。
expressions.idiom_note: McGraw-Hill 收錄的經典美式慣用語，等同 swamped。

expressions.native_en: Let's call it a day.
expressions.meaning_zh: 今天就到此為止，收工吧！
expressions.idiom_note: 若是在晚上聚會結束要散會，則可換成 Let's call it a night.

expressions.native_en: I've got to hit the road.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我得上路／動身離開了。
expressions.idiom_note: 準備啟程回家或結束拜訪時極常用的美式道別語。

expressions.native_en: Tell me about it!
expressions.meaning_zh: 可不是嘛！我超懂你的感受！
expressions.idiom_note: 不是真的要對方「告訴你」，而是表達「我也深有同感、感同身受」！

expressions.native_en: That's fair, but hear me out.
expressions.meaning_zh: 那樣講有道理，但請先聽我說明我的考量。
expressions.idiom_note: 先認同對方邏輯（That's fair）再請對方聽完不同面向，大幅降低會議防禦心。

expressions.standard_en: I am very busy and cannot do it.
expressions.native_en: I can't commit right now. I'm stretched pretty thin.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我現在沒辦法答應，手頭的事情已經讓我分身乏術了。
expressions.idiom_note: 用 can't commit（無法承諾）搭配 stretched thin（人力精力拉得很滿），專業又不傷和氣。

expressions.native_en: Could you look this over? I'm a bit stuck here.
expressions.meaning_zh: 你能幫我過目一下這份文件嗎？我這裡有點卡關了。
expressions.idiom_note: look over 比 check 更柔和，點出 a bit stuck 讓同事更願意出手幫忙。

expressions.native_en: Any chance we could push it to Thursday?
expressions.meaning_zh: 有機會把會議順延到週四嗎？
expressions.idiom_note: Any chance...? 給予對方舒適的商量空間，比 delay 更符合美商日程口語。

expressions.standard_en: I have two appointments at the same time.
expressions.native_en: I accidentally double-booked myself.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我不小心把兩個行程排撞期了。
expressions.idiom_note: 外商最道地的「撞期」說法，一句三個字就交代清楚原因。

expressions.native_en: Point well taken.
expressions.meaning_zh: 很有道理，我完全理解並接受你的觀點。
expressions.idiom_note: 正式會議與高階主管最愛用的肯定說法，展現高度專業氣度。

expressions.standard_en: I want to tell you in advance.
expressions.native_en: Just a quick heads-up.
expressions.meaning_zh: 只是先跟你提個醒／打聲招呼。
expressions.idiom_note: Slack、Email 與會議開場必備的預警起手式，瞬間拉近協作默契。

expressions.standard_en: Let us talk about the main point.
expressions.native_en: Let's cut to the chase.
expressions.meaning_zh: 我們廢話不多說，直接切入重點吧。
expressions.idiom_note: 源自電影剪接「直接跳到追逐高潮戲」，開會省時聚焦超好用。

expressions.native_en: Here's the bottom line.
expressions.meaning_zh: 核心底線／最終結論就是⋯⋯
expressions.idiom_note: 原指財報最底行的淨利，商務口語指「最關鍵的結論與底線」。

expressions.native_en: You can count on me.
expressions.meaning_zh: 你可以完全放心信賴我！
expressions.idiom_note: 面試與專案承諾時最有溫度的保證句，比 trust 更有「靠得住」的團隊感。

exercises.prompt_text: 還不錯，只是有點累
exercises.prompt_en: How's it going today?
exercises.correct_answer: Pretty good, just a bit tired.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 蠻好的，只是有點累。
acceptable_answers_json: Pretty good, just a little tired.
exercises.explanation_zh: 回答 How's it going? 用 Pretty good 開頭最自然，不必每次都背 I'm fine, thank you.

exercises.prompt_text: 沒什麼特別的，在這邊晃晃
exercises.prompt_en: What's up with you today?
exercises.correct_answer: Not much, just hanging around here.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 沒什麼事，就隨處晃晃。
acceptable_answers_json: Nothing much, just hanging out.
exercises.explanation_zh: What's up? 幾乎八成都以 Not much 開頭。

exercises.prompt_text: 對啊，很慶幸終於快結束了
exercises.prompt_en: Long day at work today, huh?
exercises.correct_answer: Yeah, I'm glad it's almost over.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 是啊，真高興終於快過完了。
exercises.explanation_zh: I'm glad it's almost over 是下班前與同事閒聊超高頻回覆。

exercises.prompt_text: 還過得去，老樣子
exercises.prompt_en: How have you been lately?
exercises.correct_answer: Could be worse. Same as usual.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 還過得去，就跟平常一樣。
acceptable_answers_json: Same as always.
exercises.explanation_zh: Could be worse 字面是「還能更糟」，實際意思是「算不錯／過得去」。

exercises.prompt_text: 恐怕去不了，明天一早有會
exercises.prompt_en: Are you coming to the party tonight?
exercises.correct_answer: I'm afraid I won't be able to make it.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我恐怕去不了。
acceptable_answers_json: I'm afraid I can't make it.
exercises.explanation_zh: make it 在邀約語境中表示「到場、赴約」。

exercises.prompt_text: 一點也不介意，儘管拿去！
exercises.prompt_en: Do you mind if I borrow your notes?
exercises.correct_answer: Not at all, feel free to take them!
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 一點都不介意，儘管拿去用！
acceptable_answers_json: Of course not, go ahead!
exercises.explanation_zh: 注意 Do you mind...? 表示「不介意」要答 Not at all / No, go ahead，千萬別說 Yes！

exercises.prompt_text: 真的很棒！窗外景色超美
exercises.prompt_en: How do you like your new office?
exercises.correct_answer: It's really nice! The view is amazing.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 真的很棒！窗外的視野好極了。
exercises.explanation_zh: 先給整體正面評價，再補一個具體細節（The view is amazing）。

exercises.prompt_text: 就是說啊！冷得要命！
exercises.prompt_en: Can you believe this weather?
exercises.correct_answer: I know, right? It's freezing!
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 就是說啊！冷得要命！
exercises.explanation_zh: I know, right? 是美式超高頻附和句，表達強烈認同。

exercises.prompt_text: 對，我才剛搬來這一區
exercises.prompt_en: Is this your first time here?
exercises.correct_answer: Yeah, I just moved to this area.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 對，我才剛搬到這一帶。
exercises.explanation_zh: move to this area / neighborhood 是自我介紹與新環境破冰常用語。

exercises.prompt_text: 我是約翰・瓊斯，請問她在等我電話嗎？
exercises.prompt_en: May I ask who is calling?
exercises.correct_answer: This is John Jones. Is she expecting me?
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我是約翰・瓊斯，請問她在等我電話嗎？
exercises.explanation_zh: 電話報名字用 This is ... speaking，不用 I am ...。

exercises.prompt_text: 不用了，謝謝你問我
exercises.prompt_en: Can I get you another cup of coffee?
exercises.correct_answer: I'm good, thanks for asking.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我不用了，謝謝你問我。
acceptable_answers_json: No thanks, I'm good.
exercises.explanation_zh: 在餐廳婉拒加點或續杯，I'm good 比直接說 No 更親切道地。

exercises.prompt_text: 好，請問試衣間在哪裡？
exercises.prompt_en: Would you like to try it on?
exercises.correct_answer: Sure, where are the fitting rooms?
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 好的，請問試衣間在哪裡？
acceptable_answers_json: Sure, where is the fitting room?
Sure, where are the changing rooms?
exercises.explanation_zh: 試衣間常以複數 the fitting rooms 稱呼。

exercises.prompt_text:
如果可以的話，能給我一個走道座位嗎？
Could I also have an ________ ________ if possible?
exercises.correct_answer: aisle seat
acceptable_answers_json: aisle seat
exercises.explanation_zh: 走道座位為 aisle seat（注意 aisle 的 s 不發音）。

exercises.prompt_text: 請翻譯：「我是來觀光的，預計停留七天。」
exercises.correct_answer: I'm here for tourism, staying for seven days.
acceptable_answers_json: I am here for tourism, staying for seven days.
I'm here for tourism and will be staying for seven days.
exercises.explanation_zh: 過海關最常被問 purpose of visit 與 length of stay，一句即可回答完整。

exercises.prompt_text:
請問總金額已經包含小費／服務費了嗎？
Does this total include the tip, or should I add the ________?
exercises.correct_answer: gratuity
acceptable_answers_json: gratuity
tip
exercises.explanation_zh: 北美餐廳帳單常用 gratuity 代表小費／服務費。

exercises.prompt_text: 請翻譯（美式完成式）：「奶奶，您起床了嗎？」
exercises.correct_answer: Granny, have you gotten up?
acceptable_answers_json: Granny, have you got up?
Grandmother, have you gotten up?
exercises.explanation_zh: 現在完成式 have + p.p.；美式慣用 gotten up，英式則用 got up。

exercises.prompt_text:
別忘了關掉水龍頭。
Don't forget to ________ ________ the faucet.
exercises.correct_answer: turn off
acceptable_answers_json: turn off
shut off
exercises.explanation_zh: 關閉水龍頭與電器標準片語為 turn off。

exercises.prompt_text: 請翻譯（美式用語）：「把垃圾拿出去倒。」
exercises.correct_answer: Take out the trash.
acceptable_answers_json: Take out the garbage.
Take out the rubbish.
exercises.explanation_zh: 倒垃圾美式常用 take out the trash / garbage，英式用 rubbish。

exercises.prompt_text:
他正在起泡的肥皂水裡洗碗盤。
I'm washing the dishes in the ________ water.
exercises.correct_answer: soapy
acceptable_answers_json: soapy
sudsy
exercises.explanation_zh: soapy 為形容詞「充滿肥皂泡沫的」。

exercises.prompt_text: 聽音檔，選出顧客想表達的核心需求：
options_json: 詢問是否有更小尺寸並想試穿
要求刷卡與開立免稅單
表示只是隨意看看不需要協助
詢問商品是否可以退貨退款
exercises.correct_answer: 詢問是否有更小尺寸並想試穿
exercises.explanation_zh: Do you have this in a smaller size? Can I try it on? 表示想找小一號並試穿。

exercises.prompt_text: 當好友說 work has been crazy busy lately，以下哪句最能展現美式高共鳴接話？
options_json: Tell me about it! Same here.
Yes, I am busy too. Goodbye.
exercises.correct_answer: Tell me about it! Same here.
exercises.explanation_zh: Tell me about it! 意為「可不是嗎！我太懂了！」，搭配 Same here. 超自然。

exercises.prompt_text:
很抱歉，他目前正在另一條線上通話。
I'm afraid he is ________ ________ ________ right now.
exercises.correct_answer: on another line
acceptable_answers_json: on another line
exercises.explanation_zh: be on another line 是商務電話「佔線中／正在講另一通電話」的道地說法。

exercises.prompt_text: 飯店櫃檯報到時，怎麼說「我用約翰遜的名字訂了三晚的房間」？
exercises.correct_answer: I have a reservation under the name Johnson for three nights.
acceptable_answers_json: I have a reservation under the name Johnson for three nights.
My reservation is under Johnson for three nights.
exercises.explanation_zh: 訂房名字固定用介系詞片語 under the name + 姓氏。

exercises.prompt_text: 退房後想把行李寄放在飯店櫃檯，該怎麼詢問？
options_json: Can you keep my luggage after check-out?
May I see your passport for incidentals?
The air conditioning does not work.
exercises.correct_answer: Can you keep my luggage after check-out?
acceptable_answers_json: Can you keep my luggage after check-out?
exercises.explanation_zh: 寄放行李常用 keep / store my luggage after check-out。

exercises.prompt_text: 搭計程車時，如何禮貌請司機「請開啟跳錶計費」？
exercises.correct_answer: Could you please use the meter?
acceptable_answers_json: Could you please use the meter?
Could you use the meter, please?
Please turn on the meter.
exercises.explanation_zh: 跳錶計費表叫 meter，用 Could you please use the meter? 最禮貌自然。

exercises.prompt_text: 問路時聽到 "Turn left at the main intersection."，意思是？
options_json: 請司機把找零當作小費
exercises.correct_answer: 在主要十字路口左轉
acceptable_answers_json: 在主要十字路口左轉
exercises.explanation_zh: intersection 就是美式英文的「十字路口」。

exercises.prompt_text: 出國不舒服想找藥局，怎麼說「我覺得不舒服，附近有藥局嗎？」
exercises.correct_answer: I'm not feeling well. Is there a pharmacy nearby?
acceptable_answers_json: I'm not feeling well. Is there a pharmacy nearby?
I don't feel well. Is there a pharmacy nearby?
exercises.explanation_zh: 不舒服用 not feeling well / don't feel well；附近有藥局嗎用 Is there a pharmacy nearby?。

exercises.prompt_text: 「只是小毛病，不是重病」在《500 Mini-Dialogues》中怎麼表達？
options_json: It is a minor ailment, not a serious illness.
exercises.correct_answer: It is a minor ailment, not a serious illness.
acceptable_answers_json: It is a minor ailment, not a serious illness.
exercises.explanation_zh: minor ailment 指輕微小病痛，與 serious illness（重病）形成對比。

exercises.prompt_text: 想用道地美式口語說「我這整週都忙翻了，真高興終於收工」，怎麼說？
exercises.correct_answer: I've been swamped all week, so I'm glad we called it a day.
acceptable_answers_json: I've been swamped all week, so I'm glad we called it a day.
I've been super busy all week. Let's call it a day.
exercises.explanation_zh: swamped 表示忙得不可開交，call it a day 表示收工。

exercises.prompt_text: 朋友問你喜不喜歡某類型電影，哪句回覆最符合美式自然語氣？
options_json: For me, it really depends on my mood.
I am very sure this movie is bad.
I have a reservation under the name Johnson.
exercises.correct_answer: For me, it really depends on my mood.
acceptable_answers_json: For me, it really depends on my mood.
exercises.explanation_zh: depends on my mood（很看心情）是日常聊天極萬用的彈性接話。

exercises.prompt_text: 我不想起來！
exercises.prompt_en: Are you not sleeping? Get up!
exercises.correct_answer: I don't want to!
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我不想起來！
acceptable_answers_json: I don't want to!
exercises.explanation_zh: 省略後方重複動詞 get up，保留 to 最符合口語節奏。

exercises.prompt_text: 沒，她睡過頭了。
exercises.prompt_en: Did she wake up at seven?
exercises.correct_answer: Nope. She overslept.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 沒，她睡過頭了。
acceptable_answers_json: Nope. She overslept.
exercises.explanation_zh: nope 比 no 更輕快自然；overslept 是 oversleep 的過去式。

exercises.prompt_text: 還沒，再給它一點時間發揮。
exercises.prompt_en: Coffee kicking in yet?
exercises.correct_answer: Not quite, give it time.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 還沒，再給它一點時間。
acceptable_answers_json: Not quite, give it time.
exercises.explanation_zh: kick in 表示「開始發揮作用」，早晨聊咖啡必學！

exercises.prompt_text: 再一分鐘就起來。
exercises.prompt_en: When are you going to get up?
exercises.correct_answer: In a minute.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 再一分鐘／馬上。
acceptable_answers_json: In a minute.
exercises.explanation_zh: in a minute 是居家最常見的「等一下就來」超短句。

exercises.prompt_text: 勉強算是，外面塞成一團糟。
exercises.prompt_en: Morning, you survived traffic!
exercises.correct_answer: Barely, it was a mess.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 勉強活過來，交通亂成一團。
acceptable_answers_json: Barely, it was a mess.
exercises.explanation_zh: a mess 形容交通大打結非常道地；barely 是「勉強」。

exercises.prompt_text: 不意外，畢竟今天是週一。
exercises.prompt_en: Elevator's taking forever.
exercises.correct_answer: Figures, it's Monday.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 不意外，今天是禮拜一嘛。
acceptable_answers_json: Figures, it's Monday.
exercises.explanation_zh: 單字 Figures. 在美劇超常出現，意思是「果然／不意外」。

exercises.prompt_text: 可以是可以，但路況會很慘。
exercises.prompt_en: Let's drive during rush hour.
exercises.correct_answer: We could, but traffic's rough.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 可以是可以，但塞車會很嚴重。
acceptable_answers_json: We could, but traffic's rough.
exercises.explanation_zh: 用 We could, but... 委婉提出擔憂，比直接說 No 好聽得多。

exercises.prompt_text: 喔原來如此，那有點遠耶。
exercises.prompt_en: It takes about an hour to get there.
exercises.correct_answer: Oh I see, that's kind of far then.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 喔我懂了，那這樣有點遠耶。
acceptable_answers_json: Oh I see, that's kind of far then.
exercises.explanation_zh: 先同理回應 Oh I see，再用 kind of 緩和語氣。

exercises.prompt_text: 是啊，我剛出門真該穿件夾克的。
exercises.prompt_en: It's kind of cold outside today, huh?
exercises.correct_answer: Yeah, I should have worn a jacket.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 對啊，我應該穿外套的。
acceptable_answers_json: Yeah, I should have worn a jacket.
exercises.explanation_zh: should have + p.p. 表達「早知道就應該⋯⋯」。

exercises.prompt_text: 我已經拿了。
exercises.prompt_en: It's raining outside. Take an umbrella!
exercises.correct_answer: I've taken it.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我已經拿了。
acceptable_answers_json: I've taken it.
exercises.explanation_zh: 現在完成式表達「已經拿在手上了」的狀態。

exercises.prompt_text: 完全殺我一個措手不及！
exercises.prompt_en: It's crazy cold outside!
exercises.correct_answer: Totally caught me off guard.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 完全讓我措手不及。
acceptable_answers_json: Totally caught me off guard.
exercises.explanation_zh: catch someone off guard 是「讓人始料未及、措手不及」。

exercises.prompt_text: 對鴨子來說倒是絕佳好天氣！
exercises.prompt_en: Lousy weather, isn't it?
exercises.correct_answer: Lovely weather for ducks!
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 只有鴨子才喜歡這種雨天！
acceptable_answers_json: Lovely weather for ducks!
exercises.explanation_zh: McGraw-Hill 收錄的英美經典幽默反諷：形容大雨下個不停。

exercises.prompt_text: 目前先給我黑咖啡就好。
exercises.prompt_en: Cream or sugar with your coffee?
exercises.correct_answer: Just black coffee for now.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 現在先黑咖啡就好。
acceptable_answers_json: Just black coffee for now.
exercises.explanation_zh: for now（目前先這樣）讓點餐口氣非常自然道地。

exercises.prompt_text: 可以再給我們幾分鐘看菜單嗎？
exercises.prompt_en: Are you ready to order?
exercises.correct_answer: Could we have a few more minutes?
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 可以再給我們幾分鐘嗎？
acceptable_answers_json: Could we have a few more minutes?
exercises.explanation_zh: 點餐還沒決定時最禮貌的回應方式。

exercises.prompt_text: 請幫我們分開結帳，謝謝。
exercises.prompt_en: Is this all on one bill?
exercises.correct_answer: Separate checks, please.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 請分開結帳，謝謝。
acceptable_answers_json: Separate checks, please.
exercises.explanation_zh: 在美式餐廳聚餐 AA 制時必備的三字神句。

exercises.prompt_text: 我覺得還行啦，沒什麼特別的。
exercises.prompt_en: Did you like the food there?
exercises.correct_answer: I think it was okay, nothing special.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我覺得還好，沒什麼特別的。
acceptable_answers_json: I think it was okay, nothing special.
exercises.explanation_zh: nothing special 是不帶攻擊性地評價「普通」的好用法。

exercises.prompt_text: 對我來說，大概不會再去第二次。
exercises.prompt_en: Would you go there again sometime?
exercises.correct_answer: For me, I probably wouldn't go again.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 以我來說，大概不會再去了。
acceptable_answers_json: For me, I probably wouldn't go again.
exercises.explanation_zh: 加上 For me 與 probably，禮貌表達個人意見。

exercises.prompt_text: 好啊，請給我冰水，謝謝。
exercises.prompt_en: Can I get you a glass of water?
exercises.correct_answer: Yes, ice water would be great, thanks.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 好啊，來杯冰水太棒了，謝謝。
acceptable_answers_json: Yes, ice water would be great, thanks.
exercises.explanation_zh: 用 ... would be great 比單說 Yes 更有親和力。

exercises.prompt_text: 冰箱快空了，我們去買菜吧！
exercises.prompt_en: Do we have enough food for tonight?
exercises.correct_answer: The fridge is almost empty. Let's go food shopping!
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 冰箱快空了，去採買吧！
acceptable_answers_json: The fridge is almost empty. Let's go food shopping!
exercises.explanation_zh: fridge 是 refrigerator 的日常縮寫。

exercises.prompt_text: 熟了，拿一串吧。
exercises.prompt_en: Are the bananas ripe?
exercises.correct_answer: Yes, take a bunch.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 熟了，拿一串吧。
acceptable_answers_json: Yes, take a bunch.
exercises.explanation_zh: 一串香蕉／葡萄的量詞都是 a bunch of。

exercises.prompt_text: 付現，錢在這裡。
exercises.prompt_en: Would you like to pay in cash or by card?
exercises.correct_answer: In cash. Here's the money.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 付現金，錢在這裡。
acceptable_answers_json: In cash. Here's the money.
exercises.explanation_zh: 注意介系詞搭配：in cash（付現）vs. by card（刷卡）。

exercises.prompt_text: 放心，我不會忘。
exercises.prompt_en: Don't forget the change!
exercises.correct_answer: I won't.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我不會忘的。
acceptable_answers_json: I won't.
exercises.explanation_zh: 英文回覆 Don't... 祈使句最道地的就是簡短的 I won't.。

exercises.prompt_text: 不要，那是冷凍的，我比較喜歡新鮮的。
exercises.prompt_en: Would you like to buy some fish?
exercises.correct_answer: No, it's frozen. I prefer it fresh.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 不要，那是冷凍的，我偏好新鮮的。
acceptable_answers_json: No, it's frozen. I prefer it fresh.
exercises.explanation_zh: prefer + 事物 + 形容詞，俐落表達偏好。

exercises.prompt_text: 我懂你的意思，但真的很值得。
exercises.prompt_en: It's way too expensive for me.
exercises.correct_answer: I see your point, but it's worth it.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我懂你的點，但這很值得。
acceptable_answers_json: I see your point, but it's worth it.
exercises.explanation_zh: I see your point, but... 是高情商表達不同看法神句。

exercises.prompt_text: 太好了，目前為止都還順利嗎？
exercises.prompt_en: I started a new job last week.
exercises.correct_answer: Nice, how's everything going so far?
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 太棒了，到目前為止一切順利嗎？
acceptable_answers_json: Nice, how's everything going so far?
exercises.explanation_zh: so far（截至目前）最適合用來關心剛開始的新工作或新計畫。

exercises.prompt_text: 還沒，手頭上還在趕。
exercises.prompt_en: Did you send the file?
exercises.correct_answer: Not yet, still working on it.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 還沒，還在處理中。
acceptable_answers_json: Not yet, still working on it.
exercises.explanation_zh: 職場被催進度時最自然、不慌張的回覆。

exercises.prompt_text: 對啊，我覺得今天做得夠多了。
exercises.prompt_en: Calling it a day soon?
exercises.correct_answer: Think I've done enough.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我覺得今天做得夠多了。
acceptable_answers_json: Think I've done enough.
exercises.explanation_zh: 省略主詞 I，展現熟人同事間的輕鬆口語。

exercises.prompt_text: 目前計畫是這樣沒錯。
exercises.prompt_en: You heading home after this?
exercises.correct_answer: That's the plan for now.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 目前打算如此。
acceptable_answers_json: That's the plan for now.
exercises.explanation_zh: That's the plan 保留彈性，代表「沒意外的話就這樣」。

exercises.prompt_text: 完全懂，我這週也忙翻了。
exercises.prompt_en: I've been super busy all week.
exercises.correct_answer: Totally, it's been crazy for me too.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 完全同意，我也忙瘋了。
acceptable_answers_json: Totally, it's been crazy for me too.
exercises.explanation_zh: Totally 是美式口語最高頻的共鳴同意詞。

exercises.prompt_text: 對啊，聽起來就超耗精力。
exercises.prompt_en: The schedule has been really tight.
exercises.correct_answer: Right, that sounds pretty exhausting.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 對啊，聽起來超累人的。
acceptable_answers_json: Right, that sounds pretty exhausting.
exercises.explanation_zh: 同理對方辛勞，用 pretty exhausting 接話超加分。

exercises.prompt_text: 還在想，還沒確定。
exercises.prompt_en: Weekend plans shaping up?
exercises.correct_answer: Still figuring that out.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 還在規劃中。
acceptable_answers_json: Still figuring that out.
exercises.explanation_zh: figure out 表示「想出來、決定好」。

exercises.prompt_text: 我現在還不完全確定。
exercises.prompt_en: Are you free Friday night?
exercises.correct_answer: I'm not totally sure yet.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我還沒完全確定。
acceptable_answers_json: I'm not totally sure yet.
exercises.explanation_zh: 保留確認空間，比直接答應或拒絕更實用。

exercises.prompt_text: 要看工作的狀況怎麼樣。
exercises.prompt_en: Think you can make it?
exercises.correct_answer: It depends how work goes.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 看工作進度如何。
acceptable_answers_json: It depends how work goes.
exercises.explanation_zh: make it 指「準時出席／趕得上」。

exercises.prompt_text: 有機會改到週日嗎？
exercises.prompt_en: Can we stick with Saturday?
exercises.correct_answer: Any chance we move it to Sunday?
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 有可能改到星期天嗎？
acceptable_answers_json: Any chance we move it to Sunday?
exercises.explanation_zh: Any chance...? 是極度禮貌且道地的商量改期開頭。

exercises.prompt_text: 老實說，比預期的還要好。
exercises.prompt_en: What did you think about the show?
exercises.correct_answer: Honestly, it was better than expected.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 老實說，比預期中好看。
acceptable_answers_json: Honestly, it was better than expected.
exercises.explanation_zh: better than expected 適合用在電影、餐廳、旅遊各種評價。

exercises.prompt_text: 我可能會晚到一點點喔。
exercises.prompt_en: See you around seven?
exercises.correct_answer: I might run a bit late.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我可能會稍微遲到一點。
acceptable_answers_json: I might run a bit late.
exercises.explanation_zh: run late 比 be late 更道地自然，先打預防針超好用。

exercises.prompt_text: 今天真的太難熬了。
exercises.prompt_en: You look wiped out.
exercises.correct_answer: It's been a day.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 今天真是漫長又累人的一天。
acceptable_answers_json: It's been a day.
exercises.explanation_zh: It's been a day. 是母語者感嘆「今天超累」的精簡金句。

exercises.prompt_text: 有哪裡感覺不對勁嗎？
exercises.prompt_en: I'm not feeling great today.
exercises.correct_answer: Something seem off?
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 有哪裡不舒服嗎？
acceptable_answers_json: Something seem off?
exercises.explanation_zh: off 在健康語境下指「狀態不佳、不太對勁」。

exercises.prompt_text: 不行，你喉嚨還在痛。
exercises.prompt_en: Buy me an ice-cream, please!
exercises.correct_answer: No, you have a sore throat.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 不行，你喉嚨痛。
acceptable_answers_json: No, you have a sore throat.
exercises.explanation_zh: sore throat（喉嚨痛）是感冒最常見症狀說法。

exercises.prompt_text: 需要找人把心事說出來聊聊嗎？
exercises.prompt_en: I'm a bit overwhelmed lately.
exercises.correct_answer: Want to talk it out?
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 想說出來聊聊嗎？
acceptable_answers_json: Want to talk it out?
exercises.explanation_zh: talk it out 指「把煩惱講開、傾訴出來」。

exercises.prompt_text: 給您，我用陳的名字訂了三晚。
exercises.prompt_en: May I see your passport and booking?
exercises.correct_answer: Here you are. I have a reservation under Chen for three nights.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 在這裡，我用陳的名字訂了三晚。
acceptable_answers_json: Here you are. I have a reservation under Chen for three nights.
exercises.explanation_zh: 遞證件時固定搭配 Here you are.。

exercises.prompt_text: 好的，請幫我設在早上七點半。
exercises.prompt_en: Would you like a wake-up call?
exercises.correct_answer: Yes, please set it for 7:30 AM.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 是的，請設在早上七點半。
acceptable_answers_json: Yes, please set it for 7:30 AM.
exercises.explanation_zh: 設定鬧鐘或叫床服務時間使用介系詞 for。

exercises.prompt_text: 我是來度假觀光的。
exercises.prompt_en: Are you visiting for business or pleasure?
exercises.correct_answer: I'm here on vacation.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我是來度假的。
acceptable_answers_json: I'm here on vacation.
exercises.explanation_zh: 過海關與搭計程車最高頻寒暄，也可說 I'm here for tourism.。

exercises.prompt_text: 大概二十元，不用找了。
exercises.prompt_en: How much is the fare to the hotel?
exercises.correct_answer: About twenty dollars. Keep the change.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 大約二十元，不用找了。
acceptable_answers_json: About twenty dollars. Keep the change.
exercises.explanation_zh: Keep the change. 是結帳時把找零當小費的經典句。

exercises.prompt_text: 沒關係，我也剛忙到忘記時間。
exercises.prompt_en: I'm sorry I'm late!
exercises.correct_answer: No worries, I almost lost track of time too.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 別擔心，我也差點忘了時間。
acceptable_answers_json: No worries, I almost lost track of time too.
exercises.explanation_zh: lose track of time 是「忘記時間流逝」的道地說法。

exercises.prompt_text: 沒事，這比你想得還常發生。
exercises.prompt_en: Oh wow, my bad, Daniel.
exercises.correct_answer: Happens more than you think.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 這很常發生啦，別在意。
acceptable_answers_json: Happens more than you think.
exercises.explanation_zh: 幫對方化解尷尬的超高情商美式回應。

exercises.prompt_text: 別介意，你完全沒冒犯到我。
exercises.prompt_en: I hope that didn't sound rude.
exercises.correct_answer: You're good, no offense taken.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 沒事，我沒有覺得被冒犯。
acceptable_answers_json: You're good, no offense taken.
exercises.explanation_zh: You're good = 沒事別在意；no offense taken = 不介意。

exercises.prompt_text: 我再幾分鐘就關掉。晚安！
exercises.prompt_en: Do not use your smartphone before bed!
exercises.correct_answer: I'll turn it off in a couple of minutes. Good night!
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我再幾分鐘就關機，晚安！
acceptable_answers_json: I'll turn it off in a couple of minutes. Good night!
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《500 Mini-Dialogues》第 500 壓軸篇：in a couple of minutes（再幾分鐘）。

exercises.prompt_text: 聽音檔，選出你在會議中提出折衷方案的核心內容：
options_json: 建議先針對一成用戶小規模試推（soft launch）
要求將產品發表全面取消並重寫程式
提議改由行銷團隊自行負責品質測試
表示完全同意週五立刻向全部用戶開放
exercises.correct_answer: 建議先針對一成用戶小規模試推（soft launch）
exercises.explanation_zh: A soft launch for ten percent of users might be one option 表示「先對一成用戶試推或許是個選項」。

exercises.prompt_text:
那說得有道理，但先聽我把話說完。
That's fair, but ________ ________ ________.
exercises.correct_answer: hear me out
acceptable_answers_json: hear me out
exercises.explanation_zh: hear me out 表示「先聽我把話說完／聽我解釋」，是美式會議委婉反對的黃金片語。

exercises.prompt_text: 請翻譯：「容我插一句，我覺得這週五有點趕。」
exercises.correct_answer: If I may jump in, I feel like this Friday is kind of tight.
acceptable_answers_json: If I may, I feel like this Friday is kind of tight.
If I may jump in, I feel like this Friday is kind of tight for QA testing.
exercises.explanation_zh: If I may (jump in) 禮貌切入發言，搭配 I feel like + kind of tight 軟化反對語氣。

exercises.prompt_text: 聽音檔，同事主動給你「heads-up」是因為發生什麼事？
options_json: 新專案的截止日期被提前了一週
專案預算被刪減了一半
經理決定取消本週的進度報告
客戶已經簽約並延後了驗收日
exercises.correct_answer: 新專案的截止日期被提前了一週
exercises.explanation_zh: They moved it up by a week! 意思是「他們把截止日提前了一週」。

exercises.prompt_text:
我現在沒辦法答應，我手頭工作已經分身乏術了。
I can't commit right now. I'm ________ ________ ________.
exercises.correct_answer: stretched pretty thin
acceptable_answers_json: stretched pretty thin
exercises.explanation_zh: be stretched pretty thin 形容工作滿載、分身乏術，是外商拒絕插單的高情商用語。

exercises.prompt_text: 請翻譯：「你能幫我過目一下這份文件嗎？我這裡有點卡住了。」
exercises.correct_answer: Could you look this over? I'm a bit stuck here.
acceptable_answers_json: Could you look this over? I'm a bit stuck on the budget slide.
Could you look this over? I am a bit stuck here.
exercises.explanation_zh: look this over 表示「過目／快速審核」，I'm a bit stuck 表示「我有點卡住了」。

exercises.prompt_text: 聽音檔，為什麼你要請求把明天的會議改期？
options_json: 臨時有突發狀況，且不小心行程撞期了
因為簡報還沒做好，想再拖延一週
因為出差班機取消，無法上網開會
因為想把會議改成純 Email 溝通
exercises.correct_answer: 臨時有突發狀況，且不小心行程撞期了
exercises.explanation_zh: Something came up and I accidentally double-booked myself 表示臨時有狀況且行程重複預約。

exercises.prompt_text:
我們要把它順延到週四嗎？
Should we ________ ________ to Thursday?
exercises.correct_answer: push it
acceptable_answers_json: push it
exercises.explanation_zh: push (a meeting) to [time] 表示將會議順延至某個新時段。

exercises.prompt_text: 請翻譯：「我在想我們能不能改期。」
exercises.correct_answer: I was wondering if we could reschedule.
acceptable_answers_json: I was wondering if we could reschedule our meeting.
exercises.explanation_zh: I was wondering if we could... 是商務英語最客氣、最不易冒犯對方的改期起手式。

exercises.prompt_text: 聽音檔，在面試收尾前你反問面試官的核心問題是什麼？
options_json: 剛上任的前九十天達到什麼成果會被視為成功
公司每年有多少天帶薪特休與年終獎金
這份職位是否每週都可以遠距在家上班
面試結果最快明天早上會不會通知
exercises.correct_answer: 剛上任的前九十天達到什麼成果會被視為成功
exercises.explanation_zh: What would success look like in the first ninety days...? 是外商面試極具加分效果的反問問題。

exercises.prompt_text:
我的執行力很紮實，大家都能信賴我。
My execution is solid and people can ________ ________ ________.
exercises.correct_answer: count on me
acceptable_answers_json: count on me
exercises.explanation_zh: count on someone 表示「信賴、倚靠某人」，在面試中能自然傳達可靠度。

exercises.prompt_text: 請翻譯：「我目前在一家科技新創擔任產品行銷。」
exercises.correct_answer: Right now, I'm in a product marketing role at a tech startup.
acceptable_answers_json: I'm in a product marketing role at a tech startup.
It's a product marketing role at a tech startup.
exercises.explanation_zh: 美式自我介紹常用 "I'm in a [領域] role at a [公司類型]"，比死板說 department 更自然專業。

exercises.prompt_text: 那樣講有道理，但先聽我說完。
exercises.prompt_en: This launch plan seems a bit risky, right?
exercises.correct_answer: That's fair, but hear me out.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 那樣講有道理，但請先聽我把話說完。
acceptable_answers_json: That's fair, but hear me out.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《口說卡關救星》：開會遇到質疑時，先用 That's fair 肯定對方，再用 hear me out 拿回發言權。

exercises.prompt_text: 我明白你的觀點，但我還沒完全被說服。
exercises.prompt_en: So, are you convinced we should go with Option A?
exercises.correct_answer: I see your point, I'm just not fully sold yet.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我明白你的論點，只是我還沒完全被說服。
acceptable_answers_json: I see your point, I'm just not fully sold yet.
exercises.explanation_zh: 委婉保留意見的經典美式說法，避免直接說 I disagree 造成對立。

exercises.prompt_text: 好，那我們直接切入重點吧！
exercises.prompt_en: Wait, I think we lost track of the main goal.
exercises.correct_answer: Fair enough. Let's cut to the chase!
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 有道理，我們直接切入重點吧！
acceptable_answers_json: Fair enough. Let's cut to the chase!
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《McGraw-Hill》第 48 單元：cut to the chase 用於把發散的會議拉回焦點。

exercises.prompt_text: 很有道理，我接受你的觀點。
exercises.prompt_en: That extra step might slow down checkout for mobile users.
exercises.correct_answer: Point well taken. Let us simplify that step.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 很有道理，我們來簡化那個步驟。
acceptable_answers_json: Point well taken. Let us simplify that step.
Point well taken. Let's simplify that step.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《McGraw-Hill》：Point well taken 展現開明與專業氣度。

exercises.prompt_text: 還沒，我手頭上還在趕工。
exercises.prompt_en: Did you send the updated file to the client yet?
exercises.correct_answer: Not yet, still working on it. Should be ready by five.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 還沒，還在處理中。五點前應該會好。
acceptable_answers_json: Not yet, still working on it. Should be ready by five.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《口說卡關救星》：回報「還沒好」時順帶給出預計完成時間（ETA），最顯專業。

exercises.prompt_text: 我現在沒辦法答應，我手頭工作已經分身乏術了。
exercises.prompt_en: Can you help cover the client deck tomorrow?
exercises.correct_answer: I can't commit right now. I'm stretched pretty thin.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我現在沒辦法答應，我手頭事情已經分身乏術了。
acceptable_answers_json: I can't commit right now. I'm stretched pretty thin.
exercises.explanation_zh: 禮貌但直接拒絕超載插單的必背美式句型。

exercises.prompt_text: 很樂意幫忙，我們一起來看一下吧。
exercises.prompt_en: Could you look this proposal over? I am a bit stuck here.
exercises.correct_answer: Happy to help! Let's review it together.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 很樂意幫忙！我們一起來過目一下。
acceptable_answers_json: Happy to help! Let's review it together.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《口說卡關救星》：Happy to help 是美商同事間最溫暖俐落的答應語。

exercises.prompt_text: 謝謝告知，我會相應調整我們的計畫。
exercises.prompt_en: Just a quick heads-up, the deadline moved up by two days.
exercises.correct_answer: Thanks, I appreciate that. We'll adjust our plans accordingly.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 謝謝，感謝你提前提醒。我們會相應調整計畫。
acceptable_answers_json: Thanks, I appreciate that. We'll adjust our plans accordingly.
exercises.explanation_zh: 結合 quick heads-up 與 adjust accordingly，完美回應突發變動。

exercises.prompt_text: 對，我不小心把行程時間撞在一起了。
exercises.prompt_en: Did something come up for tomorrow afternoon?
exercises.correct_answer: Yeah, I accidentally double-booked myself.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 對，我不小心把行程撞期了。
acceptable_answers_json: Yeah, I accidentally double-booked myself.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《口說卡關救星》：double-book oneself 精準表達行事曆撞期。

exercises.prompt_text: 那樣對我來說可能比較好。
exercises.prompt_en: This week is pretty packed. Should we push it to next week?
exercises.correct_answer: That might work better for me, too.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 那樣對我來說可能也比較合適。
acceptable_answers_json: That might work better for me, too.
exercises.explanation_zh: 用 might work better 委婉同意改期，語氣自然不生硬。

exercises.prompt_text: 聽起來不錯，有消息隨時讓我知道。
exercises.prompt_en: I should be free after three o clock tomorrow.
exercises.correct_answer: Sounds good, keep me posted!
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 聽起來不錯，有消息隨時通知我！
acceptable_answers_json: Sounds good, keep me posted!
exercises.explanation_zh: keep me posted 是約時間與等回覆最常用的美式收尾句。

exercises.prompt_text: 我們到時候看情況隨機應變吧，我明天早上再確認。
exercises.prompt_en: Are we sure about the venue for Friday?
exercises.correct_answer: Let's play it by ear. I'll confirm tomorrow morning.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我們看情況彈性安排吧，我明天早上再跟你確認。
acceptable_answers_json: Let's play it by ear. I'll confirm tomorrow morning.
exercises.explanation_zh: play it by ear（隨機應變）加上明確確認時間點，既彈性又負責任。

exercises.prompt_text: 我目前在一家科技新創擔任產品行銷。
exercises.prompt_en: So, what kind of role are you in right now?
exercises.correct_answer: It's a product marketing role at a tech startup.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 是一家科技新創的產品行銷職位。
acceptable_answers_json: It's a product marketing role at a tech startup.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《聊天交流全攻略》：用 role at a [company] 介紹現職最道地簡潔。

exercises.prompt_text: 我拿到了一個無法拒絕的絕佳錄取機會。
exercises.prompt_en: What brought you to this city last year?
exercises.correct_answer: I got a job offer I couldn't refuse.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我得到了一個無法拒絕的工作機會。
acceptable_answers_json: I got a job offer I couldn't refuse.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《聊天交流全攻略》：a job offer I couldn't refuse 既自信又帶點美式幽默感。

exercises.prompt_text: 當然，你可以完全放心信賴我。
exercises.prompt_en: Can our team rely on you during tight product launches?
exercises.correct_answer: Absolutely, you can count on me.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 當然，你可以完全放心信賴我。
acceptable_answers_json: Absolutely, you can count on me.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《McGraw-Hill》第 65 單元：count on me 傳達強烈的責任感與支持。

exercises.prompt_text: 我不敢說是最頂尖的，但非常紮實穩健。
exercises.prompt_en: How would you rate your presentation skills?
exercises.correct_answer: I wouldn't say the best, but very solid.
exercises.correct_answer_zh: 我不敢說是最頂尖的，但水準非常紮實穩健。
acceptable_answers_json: I wouldn't say the best, but very solid.
exercises.explanation_zh: 出自《口說卡關救星》：謙遜中帶自信的滿分美式答法。
